name: How often should I get a roof flashing assessment?

mainEntity.name: How often should I get a roof flashing assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's generally recommended to have a roof flashing assessment as part of a routine roof inspection every 1-3 years, or after severe weather events like hail storms or strong winds. The timing can also depend on the age of your roof and the materials used. If you notice any signs of a leak inside your home, a professional assessment should be performed immediately to pinpoint the source, which is often flashing related.
acceptedAnswer.description: Have a roof flashing assessment every 1-3 years or after severe weather. Immediate inspection is needed if you suspect a leak, as flashing is a common source.
